record.title: China’s culture-and-tourism ministry announces AI application pilot designations
record.summary: China’s Ministry of Culture and Tourism published a notice on 16 October announcing that it had selected “AI+ Culture and Tourism” application pilot projects after applications, recommendations, review and site inspections. It directs recommending units to supervise the selected organizations’ implementation. The notice establishes the designations and oversight instruction, but its linked project list could not be inspected here; no project count, names, funding, deployment or results are asserted.
organizations: Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the People’s Republic of China
Provincial and national cultural institutions named in the notice

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: A Ministry of Culture and Tourism notice published 16 October 2026 announces that the ministry selected “AI+ Culture and Tourism” application pilot projects following applications, recommendations, review and site inspections. The notice directs recommending units to supervise the responsible organizations’ implementation.

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED
claims.text: The list attachment could not be retrieved for inspection in this activation. The project count, names, funding, implementation status, timelines and measured outcomes are not established here.

evidence_gaps.description: The official pilot-list attachment could not be inspected, and no project-level implementation or funding records were checked.

brief.importance_rationale: National selection of AI application pilots in culture and tourism could influence public-sector deployment and sector procurement if projects receive meaningful resources and implementation support. The notice confirms designation and supervisory direction; project scope, resources, deployment and outcomes remain unknown, bounding its consequence.
limitations: The list attachment on the ministry site returned HTTP 403 and the browser could not parse its MS Word format. No project count or selected project name is stated.
The notice directs implementation but does not establish that any project has begun, received funding, or produced results.
The ministry signed the notice on 13 October and published it on 16 October; these dates are kept distinct.
organizations: Ministry of Culture and Tourism of the People’s Republic of China
Provincial and national cultural institutions named in the notice

technical.claimed_result: The official notice announces project designations and supervisory direction; it contains no measured technical or deployment results.
technical.demonstrated_result: The notice directly establishes selection and a supervision instruction. The linked project list and subsequent implementation are uninspected.
technical.mechanism: The ministry uses a formal application, recommendation, review and site-inspection process to select AI+culture/tourism application pilots; recommending units supervise implementation.
technical.regime: National Ministry of Culture and Tourism policy notice published 16 October 2026; signed 13 October 2026.
technical.reproducibility: Official Chinese-language notice reviewed; its linked DOC attachment was inaccessible and no project outcomes were checked.
technical.strongest_baseline: No prior pilot portfolio or implementation baseline was compared in this review.

brief.title: China’s culture-and-tourism ministry announces AI application pilot designations
brief.why_it_matters: The designation creates a national policy signal for AI applications in cultural services and tourism and assigns recommending units a supervisory role. The actual portfolio and whether the pilots receive resources or reach deployment remain unknown.
